title: Apparent model drift under label delay
prompt: Fraud-model precision appears to have fallen from 78% to 61%. Determine why.
facts: Recent-week labels are only 62% complete because chargeback outcomes mature after 30 days.
Older fully matured cohorts remain at 76-79% precision.
The apparent decline is largest in the newest cohort.
Feature distributions and model scores remain within historical ranges.
